chunks: My father narrated to him, may God be pleased with him, who said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Muhammad ibn Fuzayl al-Sayrafi, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

He said: Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to the Jinn and mankind, and appointed after him twelve Trustees. Some of them have preceded (passed away) and some remain. Each Trustee had a practice (sunnah) associated with him. The Trustees who come after Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) are upon the practice of the Trustees of Jesus (peace be upon him), and they were twelve, and the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was upon the practice of the Messiah (peace be upon him).

key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: Practice or tradition associated with an Imam

ai.seo_question: Who are the twelve Trustees appointed after the Prophet Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Khisal establishes the doctrine of the Twelve Imams as divine trustees (Wasa) succeeding the Prophet, emphasizing their continuity with previous prophetic lineages. It specifically links Imam Ali to the tradition of Jesus (Isa), suggesting a shared spiritual authority and leadership model, while noting that all twelve Imams adhered to established divine practices (Sunnah).
